en: Perfect World Movie: Ninefold The Burning Sky

The final battle of the Immortal Ancient Era begins. The Willow Deity leads the charge in search of hope, while Shi Hao sends a clone formed from a drop of true blood back through time to end the darkness once and for all. As calamity descends, the Immortal Ancient Era reaches its tragic and heroic finale.

(Source: WeTV)
